IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: increased 5xx rates on /v1/generate from 12:02 UTC. Source: rediscloud.us-east-1 control plane latency affecting managed cache (rate limiter + auth cache). Auto-pager fired.
Oncall Pager: Alex Chen — paging now. Please ack.
Alex Chen: acked. I'm looking at grafana — spike in auth-cache latencies and a cascade of 429s from our rate limiter around 12:01.
Maya Patel: seeing 504s to rediscloud endpoints in our logs: `ERR backend read timeout`. Also increased origin requests for model endpoints.
Samir Rao: I see token bucket refill failures — rate-limiter can't fetch per-customer quotas from cache, so it's defaulting to conservative deny -> 429 bursts. Impacting both hosted api and dedicated.
Irene V: confirmed customer-facing 429s for some mid-tier customers, started receiving support tickets. Severity: P1.
Alex Chen: short plan: 1) flip RL to local-cache fallback 2) increase rate-limiter grace window to allow soft-fail Open quota 3) mute non-essential telemetry to reduce pressure on backend. Doing steps now.
Maya Patel: I'm drafting a status page blurb. Suggest: 'We've detected increased error rates due to a managed cache provider incident; mitigation in progress. No data loss expected.'
Samir Rao: commands I'm running: ```bash
# enable local in-memory fallback for rate-limiter
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://internal-api/rl/config -d '{"cache_fallback":"in_memory","grace_seconds":6}'
```
Alex Chen: applied config change, switching to in-memory fallback. Observability: 429s down ~60% within 30s.
Irene V: started customer triage list: enterprise customers A, B impacted with higher error rates; CS pinged.
DevEx-Bot: Deploy bot: rollback deployed release back to v2026.02.14?confirm -> manual approved by Alex Chen.
Alex Chen: we rolled back the latest rate-limiter code (suspected that changed cache behavior exacerbated the issue). Rolling back now.
Maya Patel: after rollback + in-memory fallback, error rate trending down. Still some latency to rediscloud metrics endpoints.
Samir Rao: opening ticket with Redis Cloud: https://support.rediscloud/CASE-987654 — included our p99 traces, auth-cache keys, and timestamps. CC: account manager.
Irene V: doing handoff to night oncall (Samir) in 30 mins. Draft handoff note: 'monitor 5xx & 429s, keep in-memory fallback until Redis Cloud confirms full recovery, do not re-deploy rate-limiter changes.'
Samir Rao: ack and standing by. Also setting temporary alert to escalate if 5xx > 1% for 5m.
Maya Patel: posted status page update: 'Mitigation in progress. We have applied local fallbacks and rolled back a recent change. We will update within 60 minutes.'
Alex Chen: any customer-facing mitigations needed? Suggest temporary quota raise for affected enterprise tenants to avoid throttling on critical flows. Who can approve?
Irene V: Ops: we have emergency override for 3 enterprise customers. I'll coordinate with billing/CS to enable.
Samir Rao: NOTE: disabling cache reads entirely causes origin load to spike — we patched RL to still respect last-known rate limit for 10s to smooth. Keep an eye.
DevEx-Bot: Log snippets captured and uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-archive/1798765432/logs.tar.gz
Maya Patel: preparing follow-up incident summary for customers and internal postmortem. Any immediate action items to add?
Alex Chen: Add: timeline, exploit of cache dependency, mitigation steps (in-memory fallback, rollback, telemetry mute), and next steps (work with Redis Cloud for hard SLA review, add local cache warm-start, and more robust quota fallback).
Irene V: handing off to Samir now. Samir — I'll DM you the enterprise override keys and current observability links.
Samir Rao: got it. Taking over for night shift. Will keep channel updated every 30m until resolved.
Oncall Pager: Incident acknowledged by Samir Rao.
Maya Patel: final note for now: customers A & B have been informed via support DM. We'll publish a fuller RCA after closure. :white_check_mark:
